create_prolific_requester: create a new ProlificRequester instance using ProlificRequester.new with a MephistoDB and requester name
register_prolific_credentials: register Prolific API credentials by calling ProlificRequester.register with ProlificRequesterArgs containing an api_key
check_prolific_registration: check if a Prolific requester is registered by calling is_registered on a ProlificRequester instance
get_prolific_budget: get the available Prolific workspace budget by calling get_available_budget on a ProlificRequester instance
create_prolific_qualification: create a new Prolific participant group qualification by calling create_new_qualification with a project ID and name
